{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

This document serves as a living record for capturing, organizing, and monitoring innovative concepts across our organization.

---

| # | Date Added | Submitter | Category | Short Description | Current Status | Owner | Action Items |
|---|------------|-----------|----------|--------------------|---------------|-------|--------------|
|   |            |           |          |                    |               |       |              |

> **How to use**:
> - Add a new row whenever a team member proposes an idea.
> - Update *Status* (`New`, `In Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `Implemented`).
> - Assign an *Owner* responsible for moving the idea forward.
> - Keep *Action Items* concise – what needs to happen next?
>
> When an idea reaches implementation, mark it accordingly and archive older entries.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeasTracker.md"}

{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

This document serves as a living record for capturing, organizing, and monitoring innovative concepts across our organization.

---

| # | Date Added | Submitter | Category | Short Description | Current Status | Owner | Action Items |
|---|------------|-----------|----------|--------------------|---------------|-------|--------------|
|   |            |           |          |                    |               |       |              |

> **How to use**:
> - Add a new row whenever a team member proposes an idea.
> - Update *Status* (`New`, `In Review`, `Approved`, `Rejected`, `Implemented`).
> - Assign an *Owner* responsible for moving the idea forward.
> - Keep *Action Items* concise – what needs to happen next?
>
> When an idea reaches implementation, mark it accordingly and archive older entries.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeasTracker.md"}
